proposed_branch: Same primitive cell and coordinate framework with the alternate Ce/Dy assignment that gives P21/m (No. 11); compare it directly against Pmn21 with a common whole-profile model and submit it if it remains competitive.
reason: The submitted CIF is valid: it parses and symmetry-expands in the primitive P cell to Ce2Dy2Ni4Ge4 (12 fully occupied ordered atoms, Z=2), with the stated 4.26535 x 6.98153 x 7.35751 A Pmn21 cell, plausible periodic contacts, and strong indexing coverage. The framework also has instantiated whole-profile support. The exact Ce/Dy ordering is nevertheless unresolved. In the trace's own same-coordinate whole-profile comparison, the unsubmitted P21/m and Pmc21 Ce/Dy orderings fit at least as well as the submitted Pmn21 ordering (RMSE 0.58842 and 0.58856 versus 0.58920); an independent profile audit likewise gives 0.23520 and 0.23536 versus 0.23624. The asserted rejection uses absent approximately 0.7%-of-maximum lines near 12 degrees but does not reconcile the submitted ordering's approximately 1.09%-calculated 17.50-degree line with the observed maximum of only about 0.42%. These alternatives preserve the indexed cell, stoichiometry, full occupancy, and chemically sound topology while being symmetry-distinct, so another attempt can add a materially different viable ordered realization and quantitatively resolve the ordering.
